items.question: While you are in New York on Fri Oct 30: The Next Ten Years of Machine Learning (Prof. Theo Marchetti, tier 3 - ACM Fellow, former head of a major industry AI lab), 6:00-7:30 PM at NYU Center for Data Science, 60 5th Ave. Free with registration. Roughly 30 min from your hotel. Your AI slot for the week is already filled by the Oct 28 MIT lecture, so this would be an extra. Book it?
